summary: We’re building Copilot as a new OS for work that spans every model, every form factor, and every task. Today, we’re announcing our biggest update to Copilot to date, bringing four things together: • Autopilot: proactive and long-running agent built for the enterprise • Code: build apps with Copilot, hosted inside your company’s tenant • Home: Chat + Cowork together • Office: now fully embedded in Copilot (and Copilot embedded in Office, of course!) Plus, you can invoke Copilot in Teams, and we’re introducing Today, a proactive experience that surfaces the most important information from across M365 without needing to ask for it. The way we work is changing and so are our workflows. This update brings AI into that flow, from answering a question, to building an app, to getting work done on your behalf. We’re building Copilot as a new OS for work that spans every model, every form factor, and every task. Today, we’re announcing our biggest update to Copilot to date, bringing four things together: **•** Autopilot: proactive and long-running agent built for the enterprise **•** Code: build apps with Copilot, hosted inside your company’s tenant **•** Home: Chat + Cowork together **•** Office: now fully embedded in Copilot (and Copilot embedded in Office, of course!) Plus, you can invoke Copilot in Teams, and we’re introducing Today, a proactive experience that surfaces the most important information from across M365 without needing to ask for it. The way we work is changing and so are our workflows. This update brings AI into that flow, from answering a question, to building an app, to getting work done on your behalf. The shift from assisted coding to autonomous enterprise agents (Autopilot) fundamentally changes the SDLC equation. The bottleneck is no longer model capability—it’s context architecture and operational governance. Copilot isn’t just a dev seat anymore; it touches product, QA, security, and ops. But unlocking that scale requires predictable capacity (including models like PTUs) and robust evaluation harnesses before letting long-running agents loose in enterprise tenants. The tooling is arriving faster than most enterprise operating models can absorb it. The real leverage will come from organizations that master the context, harness, and guardrails beneath the agents. #EnterpriseAI #AIGovernance #DigitalTransformation #CloudArchitecture #SDLC #SoftwareEngineering #Copilot #PlatformEngineering #DevOp
